extracted.subtask_description: A multi-article newspaper page reporting wartime maritime, military, diplomatic and domestic-policy developments for a general readership; includes reports on legislation, regulations, and international actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposed prohibition on photographing naval/defense facilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Prohibit any persons from “knowingly” making “any sketch, photograph, photographic negative, blueprint, plan, map, model, copy or other representation” of any naval station, article or object.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Legislation (redrafted by the Senate Naval Affairs Committee) would impose penalties of $500 and six months’ imprisonment for taking photographs of any navy vessel, yard, aircraft or national defense center or object anywhere (specifically including the Philippine Islands). The Secretary of the Navy could grant exemptions. Rationale given: innocent pictures might be used by an unfriendly power.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quebec liquor-sale and entertainment restrictions
rubrics_metrics.description: Changes in conditions of alcoholic beverage sales in Quebec Province: restaurants may serve beer and wine only with meals; cafes may sell liquor, beer and wine with 40-cent meals; no liquor may be sold anywhere in the Province on Sundays and beer and wine may be sold only between 1 and 9 P.M.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All cabarets and floor shows are placed under direct control of the Quebec Liquor Commission. Curfew hours set as 2 A.M. in Montreal, 1 A.M. in Quebec City and midnight elsewhere. These are legal/regulatory limits on sales and entertainment operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Parachute-troops additional pay statute
rubrics_metrics.description: Legislation signed to provide extra pay to parachute-jumping military personnel: 'Roosevelt today signed legislation to give $100 a month additional pay to officers and $0 additional to enlisted man in the armed forces who serve in parachute-jumping units.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported as enacted law granting additional monthly pay to personnel serving in parachute units (note: OCR of enlisted amount appears faulty in the source text). This is a statutory remuneration standard for a defined military duty.

rubrics_metrics.name: Occupational decree banning Jews from public places
rubrics_metrics.description: Decree banning Jews from public parks, cafes, hotels, restaurants, boarding houses and horse races in occupied Netherlands/Croatia areas.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Violation of the German occupation authorities' decree will be punishable by imprisonment or fine. This represents an imposed discriminatory legal/regulatory restriction affecting civil rights and public access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Montreux Convention: freedom of transit and navigation principle
rubrics_metrics.description: The parties 'recognise and affirm the principle of freedom of transit and navigation' which 'shall henceforth be regulated by the provisions of the present Convention.' (Convention regarding the Regime of the Straits, Montreux, July 20, 1936.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treaty-level legal regime governing exercise of freedom of transit and navigation through the Dardanelles and Bosphorus; identifies parties and indicates that freedom of transit/navigation is subject to the Convention's provisions.
